title: o4fix v0.1.3 candidate: release build check (v2, union-gate fix)
intro: v2: rebuilt after the final review fix (overlapping burst gates are now combined with max, as in research, instead of summed). Only telemetry near bursts less than 0.5 s apart changed (0073 10.7-10.9 s, 135.5-135.6 s, 328.1-328.3 s; 0021 47.4-47.7 s); the 0021 windows below are unchanged from the first page. The last three sections compare the first release build (LEFT) with v2 (RIGHT) exactly where it changed. The RIGHT side is always the new release build of o4fix.exe (refinement on by default, edge-offset splice fix). For 0073 and 0060 the LEFT side is the research wp1c render you already reviewed: these should look identical (measured applied-correction difference under 0.7 deg in these windows). For 0021 the LEFT side is the shipped v0.1.2 repair, rendered with the identical Gyroflow project: refined bursts should look the same or calmer on the right; the powerloop bursts were not refined (over the 4 deg cap) so any difference there comes from the splice fix alone.
left: reference (0073/0060: research wp1c; 0021: shipped v0.1.2; last three: first release build)
